bundle.shortDescription: Private DarkFi desktop wallet with chat, DAO, and mining
bundle.longDescription: Nighthawk Desktop is a cross-platform DarkFi wallet featuring encrypted DarkIRC chat, private DRK and token transfers, DAO governance, Tor and Nym transport support, and bundled XMRig mining.
